info.title: Osprey observation API
info.description: Reviewed OpenAPI subset: 20 observation operations, not the complete Osprey API. Reference edition: 1.4.4. Read-only API-key restrictions require version 1.4.3 or later; older servers ignore unknown creation fields. Do not infer enforcement from a successful key-creation request alone.

get.description: One scope is required. Devices are deduplicated by UUID before pagination. Empty scopes return an empty data array and total 0. Additional scope selectors require the development snapshot; release 1.4.3 requires area_id. Live observations. last_seen is a refresh time, not proof of reachability. Development snapshot: conditional requests save response transfer only; ordinary database reads still run. All returned fields, including last_seen, affect the validator.

get.description: Newest first. No area_id means deployment-wide. include_related=true with entity_type=device also includes related link events. Invalid time or pagination values return 400. Empty results do not prove no change outside recording coverage. Development snapshot only: pagination=cursor freezes window_to and returns events/limit/has_more/next_cursor without total or offset. Offset cannot be combined with this mode. Cursors expire after 24 hours or a signing-key rotation. This is historical traversal, not lossless delivery: late backdated inserts in already traversed ranges can be missed, and retention still applies. Always verify pagination is cursor before treating the response as a cursor page; older servers ignore unknown parameters.

parameters.name: pagination
parameters.description: Optional historical traversal mode. Omit for the established offset response.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page; requires pagination=cursor and unchanged filters.

get.description: Newest created first. Invalid dates are ignored; invalid or out-of-range limits fall back to 100 and negative offsets to 0. Without area_id the query is deployment-wide. Display-name enrichment is best effort; area_deleted marks retained incidents whose area was deleted. Reading does not acknowledge or resolve incidents. Available to authenticated roles and, in the development snapshot, restricted read-only API keys. Capability api_keys.read_only_incidents advertises that access. Incident actions and upgrades remain denied. Access is deployment-wide, not tenant-bound.

get.description: BMP/SNMP observations with per-address-family rows. Optional filters; no filter is deployment-wide. Counters cover all matching rows, not only this page. Absent prefixes_received means unmeasured, not zero. Historical empty results include a notice and do not prove there were no peers. Offset pagination is not a snapshot. Available to authenticated operator, engineer and admin roles with ordinary credentials. Restricted read-only API keys receive 403; OpenAPI inclusion does not grant access.

get.description: Best-path rows from recorded or computed source perspectives, not proof of packet forwarding. device_id selects the next-hop device; selecting_device_id selects the reporting perspective. match accepts longest or covered; omitted means exact. community is substring matching. Offset is capped at 100000; narrow filters for deeper results. Counters cover the matching set. Historical empty results include a notice; history coverage and retention apply. Available to authenticated operator, engineer and admin roles with ordinary credentials. Restricted read-only API keys receive 403; OpenAPI inclusion does not grant access.

get.description: Reconstructed from stored topology links, not a live router neighbor-table read or a protocol-state-machine dump. One row per neighbor device and area; parallel links collapse. area_id in each row is the protocol label, falling back to the UUID. neighbor_id is the router ID; device_id is the UUID. Sorted by area label then router ID. Unresolved endpoints are omitted. Summary down counts every state other than up. Missing interfaces produce empty address/name strings. Empty membership or unmatched area yields an empty neighbors array. Available to authenticated operator, engineer and admin roles with ordinary credentials. Restricted read-only API keys receive 403; OpenAPI inclusion does not grant access.

parameters.name: area_id
parameters.description: Optional area UUID or protocol label, such as 0.0.0.0. Filters the device membership areas.

event_type.description: Recorded event type. The listed vocabulary is extensible; accept unfamiliar values from newer servers or retained history.

config.description: Role-dependent recorder configuration. Credentials are redacted for operator users and read-only API keys. This field is not needed for area discovery.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation token; null on the last page.

detail.description: Extensible correlation or detector-specific evidence; root cause is an assessment, not proof of physical failure.

events.description: Optional child events. Omitted when empty; an event-loading failure returns 500. Retention can remove older associated events.
